entities.summary: Declan Kennedy is an Irish architect. He was a leader of the Global Ecovillage Network Europe (1995–99), Director of the Permaculture Institute for Europe (1984–89), and Vice President of Technische Universität Berlin (1975–78). He has been Professor of Architecture at the TU Berlin since 1972.
